zh.chartTitle: 某 App 广告：日活「一年涨 3 倍」！请看对比图（单位：万人）

textRefs.debunk_axis: 纵轴起点被抬到 25——10 万到 30 万的差距被拉成陡峭直线！真实基线该是 0；而且竞品同样从 10 涨到 29，这更像是全行业的风口，不是它一家厉害。

manual: 纵轴是从 0 开始，还是从某个高位起？再想想：涨的只有它一家吗？
zh.explanation: 这张图只动了一个手脚：纵轴从 25 起，把 10→30 的常规增长放大成「爆发」错觉。真实起点是 0。会拆弹的人，先把这个轴拽回地面，再问一句：同行是不是也涨了？

en.chartTitle: An App ad: Daily users "tripled in a year"! See the comparison (unit: 10k users)

textRefs.debunk_axis: The Y axis starts at 25 — the gap from 10 to 30 is stretched into a steep line! The honest baseline is 0; and the rival also rose from 10 to 29, so this looks more like an industry-wide wind than one company's feat.

manual: Does the Y axis start at 0, or from some high point? And think: did only this one grow?
hints: Check whether the Y axis starts at 0
en.explanation: This chart cheats only once: the Y axis starts at 25, blowing a normal 10→30 climb into an 'explosion' illusion. The honest baseline is 0. A good defuser first drags the axis back to the ground, then asks: did rivals grow too?
